look_here_first: Think glossy narrow red-oak-type foliage: Canby oak has dark glossy evergreen to semi-evergreen leaves with serrated to bristle-tipped margins and a distinctly horticultural landscape presence in Texas.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: often narrower-leaved than common Central Texas native red oaks

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: red-oak-group acorns maturing in the second season

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: commonly encountered as a landscape tree rather than wild native

lookalikes.differences: Retain only as a nursery/landscape comparison. It is not a project-native oak.
